notes: 勾选自动拉取/推送后立即判断并同步（不等 2 分钟周期）：新增 checkAndQueueAutoSync 核心函数，scheduleAutoStart、triggerAutoSyncOnClose、handleSettings 三路复用。开关变更时若已开启且仓库就位，立即判 drift→满足条件即排队 watcher 并关闭 DSH；手动触发模式跳过确认框。保留 0.3.93-0.3.98 全部修复。
notesEn: Auto pull/push now triggers immediately on toggle (no 2-min wait): new checkAndQueueAutoSync core function reused by scheduleAutoStart, triggerAutoSyncOnClose, and handleSettings. When autoPull/autoPush is turned on and repo is ready, it instantly checks drift and queues watcher + closes DSH if criteria met; manual-trigger mode skips confirm dialog. Keeps all 0.3.93-0.3.98 fixes.
